task: Layer 6 T2 (PREREG.md 'Layer 6'): latent regimes with state-dependent means. Gaussian HMM K=2,3 on (b_t, SPY ret, log RV21, dispersion, MASTER trailing-13w IC); Markov-switching regression of b_{t+1} on 13w IC; development gate 2015-2019; read 2020-2025 only for a passer.

plan.inputs: Reuse L6_complexity frozen weekly series (.cache/tree/l6/) if present and its checks pass; else build after ~30 min wait from dev.npz master_h5_ref with L4_exploit/run.py's simulator (S0 book: MASTER deciles, gross 0.6, 5 bp, beta-hedged), checked vs L4_exploit/b0_audit_runner/weekly_b0_ledger.csv book_net_return 2020-2025.
plan.state_vector: y_t = (b_t, SPY weekly return, log RV21, cross-sectional dispersion of 5-day returns, MASTER trailing 13-week IC), each standardised by expanding mean and sd known at t (b standardised for fitting; E/Var mapped back to raw b units).
plan.hmm: Own EM (no hmmlearn/statsmodels installed; nothing pip-installed). Full covariance, K in {2,3}. Expanding window from the first usable week; refit every 13 weeks using rows < t only; 20 random starts (seeded k-means++-style random means from data rows, covariances = sample cov, uniform-ish transition 0.9 diag), up to 500 EM iterations, tol 1e-6; best log-likelihood kept; states relabelled by ascending mean of b. Covariance floor 1e-4 I.
plan.filter: Hamilton forward filter only (never smoother), run with the current refit's parameters on data up to t: p_t = P(s_t | y_1..y_t). Predictive P(s_{t+1}|F_t) = p_t' A. E[b_{t+1}] = sum q_k mu_k^b; Var = sum q_k (sigma_k^bb + mu_k^b^2) - E^2 (in raw b units via the expanding standardisation at t).
plan.exposure: raw_t = E/Var; pi_t = raw_t / expanding mean of raw up to t (unit expanding mean), clipped to [0,2]. Negative raw -> clipped to 0. If expanding mean of raw <= 0 then pi_t = 1 (fallback recorded).
plan.msr: Two-regime Markov-switching regression b_{t+1} = c_s + beta_s IC13_t + e, sigma_s (switching variance), own EM with Hamilton filter/Kim smoother inside estimation only (estimation on in-sample rows < t is allowed); the trading signal uses filtered probabilities only. Same expanding refit every 13 weeks, 20 starts. E/Var from the predictive mixture; same pi mapping.
plan.records: BIC, transition diagonal, share of time in each state (filtered argmax over the fit window), log-likelihood per refit, for every configuration.
plan.leakage_test: For sample dates t, perturb all inputs at rows > t (random noise, both b and states) and rerun the full pipeline; every pi_s for s <= t must be identical (exact equality).
plan.gate: 2015-2019 after a 104-week burn-in (burn-in from start of data; weeks evaluated must have >=104 weeks of history and lie in 2015-2019). Paired weekly difference x_t - b_t at matched average exposure (x scaled so its mean exposure over the gate window equals 1, i.e. divide by mean pi in-window). Ledoit-Wolf HAC Sharpe-difference t >= 2.0 and diff positive in >= 3 of 5 years. Three configurations: HMM2, HMM3, MSR2.
plan.read: Only a passer: create READ_L6T2.lock first, compute 2020-2025 series (walk-forward MASTER scores, same simulator), whole-fund level paired against B0 via L4_exploit simulator, HAC test, DSR with N = 162 + all Layer 6 configurations evaluated on development data (from L6_complexity's count plus 3).
plan.amendment_before_gate: 2026-11-20 ~18:00 UTC, before any gate statistic was computed: align with L6_complexity's registered plan so the Layer 6 configurations share conventions: timing cost uses the week's actual book gross G_t = sum|w| + |w_spy| (not the nominal 0.6), and gate statistics use returns x 7/days (L4 wk convention). Exposure normalisation stays as this plan (raw mean, fallback 1). The dev series is my own build from the identical simulator (L6_complexity had produced no series file at ~30 min); its b definition is identical by plan.
